about: Generic scale facts the scale check uses (every number has kind and source; most are weak or guesses because they are from memory). dimension: height = z extent; width = larger horizontal extent; depth = smaller horizontal extent; thickness = smallest of the three extents; middle = middle of the three; span = largest; pitch = roof slope in degrees; gauge = distance between wheel ruts (read from the settings, not from an object); rise = how far a stone.step stands above what it rests on or the next lower step (read from the construction check, top to top). free_span = the longest free stretch between supports that a role's max_span_metres would refuse but the real thing has (a hall's tie beam between its walls, a gallery bay); only a place's own fact with a max and a source allows it, and only the judge reads it. only_if_slab_like: used only when the object's smallest extent is at most 0.4 of its middle one, so a whole building in one object is not read as one thick wall. A fact applies to an object when its role matches applies_to_role (a regular expression) and, if given, its name matches applies_to_name. A place adds or replaces facts in its own facts file (the planner researches them with sources).
